scope: Actual PostgreSQL authorization migration + real consent policy + delegate boundary probes; not a complete Places/save integration
tests: original delegate bodies are unchanged and inaccessible to client roles
unqualified caller reaches none of the three mutation delegates
qualified owner retains original RPC return contracts and writes
original owner validation remains effective after authorization
withdrawn AI permission rejects all mutation entrypoints without a write
new legal revision invalidates stale acceptance before writes
fixed-snapshot isolation is rejected
anonymous direct execution and helper bypass are denied
save first locks consent through commit; concurrent withdrawal commits afterward
withdrawal first makes a waiting save recheck current consent and write nothing
withdrawn service role cannot commit a saved destination, source, result, or successful terminal transition
worker role remains guarded through security definer and with a non-null auth UID
authenticated ordinary manual save and personal fields do not require recognition permission
qualified worker commits all four write paths
withdrawal blocks later automated identity, source, note and result changes
owner-only transfers, personal fields, source photos and notification bookkeeping survive withdrawal
service-role save holds consent until its own transaction commits
withdrawal-first service-role write waits, rechecks, and changes no saved data
legacy insert-missing: save-first blocks administrative revocation until save commit without deadlock
legacy insert-missing: revocation-first rejects waiting save before any write
legacy upsert-missing: save-first blocks administrative revocation until save commit without deadlock
legacy upsert-missing: revocation-first rejects waiting save before any write
legacy upsert-existing: save-first blocks administrative revocation until save commit without deadlock
legacy upsert-existing: revocation-first rejects waiting save before any write
